notes: Contact CCM Prep at 513-556-2595 or ccmprep@uc.edu.
name: CCM Prep Strings Intensive
org: University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music (CCM Prep)
what_you_do: A one week summer program for high school string players. You play in small groups and a string orchestra. You learn from pros in master classes. It ends with a concert.
who_can_apply: Students going into grades 9 to 12 who play a string instrument. You need to audition. You also need one letter of support.
pay_detail: Tuition $900. $35 audition fee; email ccmsummer@ucmail.uc.edu about fee waivers.
deadline_text: Auditions opened Oct 1, 2026. Priority deadline Feb 15, 2027. Final deadline March 15, 2027.
how_to_apply: Audition through Acceptd. Choose CCM Prep: Strings Intensive. Send a headshot and two different pieces, 8 to 10 minutes in all. Send a letter from a teacher or pro.
